title: Hearing on micromobility safety and delivery worker rules
summary: The Council's Transportation, Consumer and Worker Protection, and Public Safety Committees held a joint oversight hearing on September 30, 2026 examining regulation, accountability and safety of e-bikes, e-scooters, mopeds and delivery services. The hearing also covered roughly two dozen bills addressing topics such as banning the fastest e-bikes, requiring moped registration and retailer disclosures, delivery worker safety data and insurance, bike share safety reporting, and traffic calming in bike lanes. Two resolutions urged the state to pass laws on commercial e-bike licensing and penalties for e-scooter hit-and-runs.
